title: First process equipment installed at Beccs Stockholm
summary: Stockholm Exergi reports that the first process equipment has been installed at Beccs Stockholm, its bio-CCS plant under construction. The company describes this as another construction milestone for the project.
why_it_matters: Beccs Stockholm is one of the largest planned Nordic biogenic CO2 sources; construction progress informs timing assumptions for Baltic Sea shipping and storage capacity.
